definition: a person who loves and helps their country
description: A young woman in a dark beanie, a muddy jacket and rubber boots stands on a grassy riverbank at dusk and lifts a heavy sandbag onto a wall of sandbags, where water is spilling through. Behind her, a long line of people passes more sandbags along; a man in a dark jacket brings the next one. She presses her bag into place. The river beside them has flooded the fields. Each of these volunteers is a patriot who protects the town in a flood out of love for the country.
